standard.summary: 同时保留在 GPU 上的 block 数（当前 block 加最近用过的若干个，按 LRU 淘汰）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How many blocks stay on the GPU at once -- the current block plus a few recently used ones, evicted by LRU.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 同时保留在 GPU 上的 block 数（当前 + 前/后向预取）。越大越快、越吃显存。

advanced_en.principle: Number of blocks kept on the GPU at once (current + forward/backward prefetch). Larger is faster and more VRAM-hungry.
